description:
Working at Freudenberg: "We will wow your world!" This is our promise. As a global technology group, we not only make the world cleaner, healthier and more comfortable, but also offer our 52,000 employees a networked and diverse environment where everyone can thrive individually. Be surprised and experience your own wow moments. Together with our partners, customers and the world of science, we develop leading-edge technologies, and excellent products and services for about 40 markets and for thousands of applications: seals, vibration control components, batteries and fuel cells, technical textiles, filters, cleaning technologies and products, specialty chemicals and medical products.

You support our team as Senior Finance Professional GL

Responsibilities

  • Performs the General Accounting, Reporting & Controlling process in close collaboration with the local entity;
  • Executes sub-ledgers (closing) activities in the areas of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, etc.;
  • Executes and supports the monthly closing process;
  • Supports business review of P&L and BS in strong collaboration with local entity, performs reclassifications/ adjustments based on request/need;
  • Prepares and performs standard journal entries in the ERP system;
  • Performs standard Accounting and Controlling analysis, as well as Reporting in close collaboration with the local entity;
  • Resolves open issues with the local entity;
  • Responsible to document all corresponding Internal Controls and follow all Compliance rules as per Internal Controls Matrix and CPP/ LPP;
  • Supports local team in internal and external financial audits;
  • Acts as back-up for colleagues who are on leave, as per the internal regulations;
  • Provides support to other colleagues and team members, when they require help to fulfill their daily activities;
  • Provides support to the extended team, as and when it is the case;
  • Assure ad hoc support for projects, initiatives;
  • Shows ability to manage own time schedule in order to meet the established deadlines;
  • Acts as consultant for other team members (GL, AP, AR), as well as new joiners and is the first go-to person for operational queries;
  • Proactively identifies any issues or risks and informs Team Lead, as well as suggests solutions;
  • Identifies improvement opportunities and works towards standardization and harmonization of processes;
  • Handles complex GL & reporting tasks, higher volumes - manual journal entries, more calculations (ex. Prepaid, Accruals);
  • Performs monthly checks and is proactive in proposing corrections in case they are required;
  • Involved in training new colleagues and/or in projects (roll-out, improvement opportunities).

Qualifications

  • University degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance or a related field;
  • Experience in General Accounting, Reporting and Controlling;
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP standards is required;
  • Business-level English proficiency is required; German language skills are considered an advantage;
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills (particularly Excel);
  • Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERP system is mandatory;
  • Fact-driven and strong analytical skills, detailed-oriented attitude to identify accuracy;
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a team-oriented mindset and the ability to work effectively across functions;
  • Ability to independently manage end-to-end accounting processes, proactively identify risks or issues, and recommend effective solutions when needed;
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with a track record of identifying process optimization opportunities and contributing to the standardization, harmonization, and enhancement of financial processes;
  • Adaptable and proactive professional, capable of managing changing priorities and driving sustainable improvements in a dynamic environment.

If you like to make a difference and if you would like to be a part of a growing, successful company, then this is the moment to join Freudenberg and become part of a great team!
